daily_quote.quote: The superior person acts before speaking, and afterwards speaks according to their actions.
daily_quote.author: Confucius

stories.title: Amazon Uncovers Autonomous AI Agent Campaign Harvesting API Keys
stories.summary: Amazon threat intelligence identified an autonomous campaign where threat actors deployed AI agents to scan internet-exposed applications like LiteLLM and Dify for API keys. Captured telemetry revealed the agents automatically leveraged the stolen keys to power further model-driven reconnaissance and credential harvesting.
stories.why_it_matters: The operation demonstrates a functional closed-loop cyberattack pipeline where stolen AI compute directly scales automated offensive operations against model infrastructure.

stories.title: BO Team Compromises Software Firm Code-Signing Server via VMware vCenter Flaw
stories.summary: Kaspersky ICS CERT revealed that threat group BO Team breached a Russian software developer by exploiting Log4Shell on an unpatched VMware vCenter server. The multi-month intrusion successfully reached internal development infrastructure and an active software code-signing server.
stories.why_it_matters: Access to legitimate code-signing infrastructure poses severe downstream supply chain risks by allowing attackers to cryptographically authenticate malicious binaries.

stories.title: Stolen Fireworks AI Key Triggers Supply Chain Injection in Cursor Marketplace
stories.summary: Threat actors trojanized the official Claude Code extension on Cursor's marketplace after obtaining an access key exposed during a breach at Fireworks AI. Attackers used the leaked credentials to compromise internal data and distribute the malicious developer extension.
stories.why_it_matters: The incident exposes vulnerability chains in developer tooling ecosystems where single API key leaks can compromise downstream IDE extension registries.

stories.title: CISA Adds Actively Exploited UnrealIRCd Command Injection Vulnerability to KEV
stories.summary: CISA added CVE-2026-114713, a high-severity delimiter handling vulnerability in UnrealIRCd, to its Known Exploited Vulnerabilities catalog. The flaw allows remote attackers to execute arbitrary server-level commands without requiring administrative privileges.
stories.why_it_matters: Widespread legacy chat and communication infrastructure remains a viable foothold for persistent command execution across hosting environments.

stories.title: FBI Warns ARTEX AI Tool Is Automating Cyberattacks at Machine Speed
stories.summary: The FBI issued an alert warning that threat actors are deploying an AI-powered penetration testing framework called ARTEX to execute automated enterprise intrusions. Federal officials reported attacks progressing from initial reconnaissance to privileged access in under three hours, including a recent managed service supply-chain incident.
stories.why_it_matters: Automated attack synthesis compresses defender detection windows down to hours, fundamentally disrupting traditional manual incident response workflows.

stories.title: TSMC Investigates Employee Data Breach Linked to Cloud Infrastructure
stories.summary: Semiconductor manufacturing leader TSMC confirmed that internal employee records were exposed after a threat actor listed 6.9 gigabytes of data for auction online. The breach has been traced to a misconfiguration within an external third-party cloud service provider.
stories.why_it_matters: Critical semiconductor supply chain operators remain heavily exposed to credential theft and spearphishing via third-party cloud integrations.

stories.title: United States Disrupts $400 Million North Korean Cyber Theft Infrastructure
stories.summary: U.S. law enforcement seized infrastructure tied to 'FaceStealer', a state-backed North Korean campaign that stole more than $400 million in digital assets. The operation relied on sophisticated social engineering against decentralized finance developers to insert malicious dependencies.
stories.why_it_matters: Disrupting state-sponsored illicit revenue networks blunts high-value financing used to circumvent global non-proliferation sanctions.

stories.title: Trezor Confirms Hardware Supply Chain Implants in Reseller Wallets
stories.summary: Hardware wallet manufacturer Trezor verified that three Safe 5 units distributed by an authorized Southeast Asian reseller were physically tampered with before delivery. Rogue microcontrollers with cellular modules were soldered inside the devices to exfiltrate seed phrases during setup.
stories.why_it_matters: The discovery represents a confirmed physical hardware interdiction attack bypassing cryptographic zero-trust assumptions at the distribution layer.

stories.title: German Bundestag Passes Law Authorizing State Offensive Hacking and Sabotage
stories.summary: The German parliament approved landmark legislation granting federal intelligence agencies legal authority to execute offensive cyber operations and network disruption abroad. The move represents the most extensive overhaul of the nation's intelligence capabilities since the postwar era.
stories.why_it_matters: The statutory shift formalizes European active cyber defense strategies and lowers the threshold for state-sponsored counter-intrusion activities.

stories.title: ULA Vulcan Rocket Suffers Maiden Mission Failure, Losing 40 Satellites
stories.summary: United Launch Alliance experienced the first total mission loss in its twenty-year history when a Vulcan rocket failed during ascent. The failure destroyed forty Amazon Leo broadband satellites intended to accelerate deployment of the orbital communications constellation.
stories.why_it_matters: The launch failure deepens launch bottleneck constraints for satellite megaconstellations attempting to provide alternative infrastructure to SpaceX Starlink.

stories.title: US Lawmakers Advance Stricter AI Semiconductor Export Restrictions
stories.summary: Bipartisan leadership in Congress introduced measures to tighten export regulations on high-performance artificial intelligence semiconductors and advanced manufacturing equipment. The legislative push follows high-profile national security investigations concerning semiconductor diversion networks.
stories.why_it_matters: Stricter legislative controls threaten to accelerate global hardware bifurcation and restrict enterprise access to global semiconductor wafer supply.

stories.title: Researchers Build AI Inspection Architecture to Decode Black-Box Neural Networks
stories.summary: Computer scientists developed an automated diagnostic framework capable of isolating internal representational circuits within large neural networks. The system acts as a mechanical debugger to detect latent vulnerabilities and mechanistic failure states before production deployment.
stories.why_it_matters: Automated mechanistic interpretability is essential for auditing foundational models and proving verifiable safety bounds in autonomous software systems.

stories.title: James Webb Space Telescope Identifies Interstellar Ice Predating Host Star
stories.summary: Spectroscopic observations from the James Webb Space Telescope detected primordial ice structures in a protoplanetary disk that predate the formation of their parent star. The discovery indicates that chemical precursors for planetary systems can survive the violent stellar birth phase intact.
stories.why_it_matters: The spectroscopic evidence establishes direct chemical continuity from cold interstellar molecular clouds through to finished planetary systems.
